svg.title: Ceduljica · sunny paper plaza / style tile
svg.desc: Original Ceduljica concept art anchors the visual family. Authored vector controls demonstrate quiet paper, bold purple outlines, warm hard shadows, visible focus, explicit status and static reduced-motion behavior.

svg.text: Selected original Ceduljica PNG · atmosphere, elastic poses, paper and depth

g.text: Sunny layers and oversized curves frame the task.
Pals jump at the perimeter; paper stays still and clear.
Shape first. Not a token reskin.
Coral arches · open sky · warm motif paving
Broad ribbons · purple ink · warm hard offsets
No generated copy, extra controls or unsupported character props.
Sound follows a gesture; visual feedback always remains.
Built for legibility, keyboard access and less motion
Rounded system headings · 52/52 display, 36/40 title · body 16/24 · mobile notes 17/25 · no font dependency
44 px targets minimum · level, opaque forms · 200% zoom · 320 px reflow · focus contained and restored in dialogs
Canvas-only 48 s drift; reduced motion = static motif, zero tilt, no stagger. Pals and confetti are aria-hidden.

svg.text: Original Ceduljica art used by approval. Raster atmosphere is a reference; all labels, inputs and controls above are authored vectors.
